scripts.toolchain:verify: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const toolchain=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('.toolchain.json', 'utf8')); const root=require('./package.json'); if (root.engines.node !== toolchain.node) throw new Error('Node engine mismatch'); console.log('Toolchain pin verified');"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:contracts && npm --prefix apps/api run dev
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:contracts && npm --prefix apps/web run dev
scripts.build:web: npm run build:contracts && npm --prefix apps/web run build
scripts.build:api: npm run build:contracts && npm --prefix apps/api run build
scripts.build: npm run build:contracts && npm --prefix apps/api run build && npm --prefix apps/web run build
